michelle: Quick thread — need to align on evidence classification for the compliance sprint. Customers' asks are all over the map; want a simple matrix mapping evidence types -> retention tiers -> BYOK impact. Can folks chime in with tradeoffs? :thinking:
aj: Quick ask — can we get a matrix with columns: evidence type, retention default, BYOK allowed?, exportable?, audit SLI impact
devon: +1. Also include estimated daily ingest size and whether entry needs to be indexable (search) vs cold-archive.
ethan: FYI SOC2 wants immutable logs for 90 days, some ISO regimes ask for up to 2 years for certain records. We should support per-tenant overrides.
tara: Ops constraint — Dedicated & Private can do per-tenant retention easily, hosted is harder (cost & latency of long-tail storage).
michelle: Proposal: three retention tiers — ephemeral (30d), standard (1yr), long-term (7yr). BYOK allowed for standard + long-term only. Exportable flag for long-term by default. Thoughts?
aj: Implementation note: for hosted BYOK flow we need handshake + escrow. Sketch: ```on BYOK request -> initiate handshake -> verify key policy -> bind tenant -> schedule rotation windows``` This adds ~2-3 day onboarding friction for customers.
devon: For audit logs we must guarantee append-only properties. Options: HMAC-chained batches or per-entry signatures. HMAC chain is low-cost and gives tamper evidence.
ethan: Compliance will ask for tamper evidence + notarization. Recommend HMAC chain per-batch + periodic notarization (publish daily root hash to customer's audit artifact).
tara: Ops: notarization frequency drives extra ops and storage metadata. Daily hash publication is cheap and keeps forensic windows small.
michelle: Customer impact: BYOK customers typically want longer retention + export guarantees. We should include a BYOK-retention surcharge line in pricing and a clear SLA for exports.
aj: Also we need a rollback/fallback policy: if BYOK handshake fails or key policy is incompatible, fallback to platform KMS with customer notification & documented opt-out.
devon: Launch acceptance criteria suggestion: 1) per-tenant retention config UI + API, 2) BYOK handshake docs + test harness, 3) audit-log append-only proof + e2e integrity test, 4) export pipeline for evidence bundles.
ethan: Add acceptance tests: simulate legal hold, export a 1GB evidence bundle, verify signatures + hash chain, measure export time and integrity.
michelle: Timeline idea: MVP (per-tenant retention toggles + docs) in next sprint; BYOK pilot & notarization in two sprints. PMs — please flag priority pilot customers. @aj @tara
aj: Flagging: AcmeCorp and FinTechInc for pilot; both need retention >1yr and BYOK.
deploy-bot: reminder: new branch created — `compliance/evidence-matrix` :information_source:
michelle: OK — I'll draft the evidence classification matrix (mapping types like "api-logs", "audit-events", "user-uploaded-evidence", "metrics-snapshots") and share a link. Action items: michelle (draft matrix), aj (BYOK flow diagram + notes), devon (append-only spec + perf impact), tara (ops cost estimate + hosting constraints), ethan (acceptance test plan). Will check back EOW. :white_check_mark:
